notes.title: Chapter 5 Out Now — Cyber Manhunt 2: New World is Complete!
notes.notes:
[h3]Chapter 5 of [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] is officially out! With that, we are out of the early access phase and now a full release! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=IXz7CayhVKw;full][/previewyoutube]
With the Chapter 5 update, the [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] story has come to an end. To all players who have been waiting for this finale, we thank you for your patience and support, and we hope this chapter is satisfying for everyone.  

[b]We have also left an easter egg in Chapter 5... And players who have been closely observing our studio may have noticed a little hint that we left at the start of this year on Apple and Google App Stores. [/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/7f13ce347b2cfad03252b5ae2ea2f2b319785e19.png[/img]

We are delighted to have this opportunity to live the dream of becoming a game developer. Although there are some differences from the previous installment of Cyber Manhunt, we believe that its core is the same - that is, despite the set-up of a world full of bad people, the idea of love and goodwill is conveyed to everyone. 

The "Cyber Manhunt" series started in 2021 and it has been 4 whole years since then.

[b] We at the studio have been continuously growing: polishing the graphics, optimizing the gameplay, upgrading the UI, getting better at integrating social engineering into the game... And we have you, the players, to thank for being steadfast by our side.[/b]

At offline game exhibitions and events, we frequently meet players who come by to chat with us, and it always warms our heart to see you, and we become even more determined to get this game right.

The game touched many topics — online safety, information privacy, school bullying, loan sharks... We hope that through the "Cyber Manhunt" series, our players become better informed and we are able to help build a better and safer internet and world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/192d7f04dca688f8b4e1563ccb2a650f6a46a06d.jpg[/img]

[b] Even if the impact may be small, but we believe that as long as a single player has gained something from this game, then our efforts would not be for nothing.

[/b] As we carry this hope with us, we shall continue to work hard to send our message to the world. Regardless, we take pride in what we have made, and with the final chapter of this game, we can finally let out a small breath and give ourselves a pat on the back and a break.

Compared to the previous "Cyber Manhunt", this game has much more gameplay, drama, performance and voice acting. Hence, the cost of production has greatly increased and we are unable to keep the game price of [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] the same as four years ago. [b]After the launch period discount, we will have to increase the price of the game from USD 9.99 to USD 12.99 (and other regions will have a corresponding increase as well) so we hope you understand that this decision was not an easy one to make. [/b]

[h3]However, after our brief break, we will continue to update some extra content for free:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i] game soundtrack will be made available to everyone for free
[*] Based on player feedback, we will continue to polish our free desktop pet DLC "Van's Partner in Crime" and add more functions to it 
[/olist]

[b]Once again, I would like to thank all players for the continuous love and support and you will enjoy the content above[/b]

Last but not least, we have joined up with another sci-fi story-driven game, Minds Beneath Us, which has an "Overwhelmingly Positive" review on Steam , to create a wonderful bundle just for the sci-fi lover in you! Get an extra 12% off when you purchase our games through the "Cyber Minds" bundle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/736e252f728272ef2fe2b11efa1762c405b4456e.jpg[/img]

Cyber Detective, the New World is upon us, will you rise to meet it?

We have wonderful news to share with everyone! Our efforts have finally paid off and Chapter 5 will be ready for decoding on 21st January!

With the release of the final chapter of [i]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/i], we will graduate from Early Access and officially become a Full Release game! To celebrate this major milestone, we will have an [b]all-time-best discount of 12% off, making it only USD 8.79 for two weeks[/b]!

[previewyoutube=UT8iqe0H57g;full][/previewyoutube]

Why would someone with a fulfilling personal and professional life like Nathan Richter suddenly disappear without a trace? Is his mysterious disappearance linked to chip implanted in his brain? Once again, your intellect and social engineering is put to the test as you uncover the manipulation and resistance hidden behind the social order.

notes.title: A Letter from the Developers of Cyber Manhunt 2: New World
notes.notes:
Hello Cyber Detectives!

Thank you everyone for your patience and support for Cyber Manhunt 2: New World. We regret to inform you that due to some delays in the localization progress, the release date of Chapter 5 will be postponed to January 2025.

In our initial roadmap, after Cyber Manhunt 2: New World's early access release in May 2024, we planned to gradually release Chapters 4 and 5 before the end of the year. However, as we progressed, we encountered unexpected challenges with the localization process, particularly regarding the availability of our overseas translation, voice acting, and QA teams during the long Christmas holiday. While Chapter 5 is now complete, these factors mean we won’t be able to release it in 2024 as originally intended.

Localization is a meticulous process that requires multiple rounds of polishing, proofreading, and testing to ensure the highest quality experience. Our overseas team is working diligently to complete the localization as quickly as possible. However, to ensure the game has minimal bugs and maintains the content quality you expect, we need additional time to improve and adjust the game. For these reasons, we made the difficult decision to postpone the release date of Chapter 5.

This decision was not made lightly, and we understand everyone's disappointment. Once again, we would like to extend our deepest apologies to all of you who have been patiently supporting us and waiting for the continuation of Cyber Manhunt 2: New World. However, we would also like to assure everyone that we are determined to complete Cyber Manhunt 2: New World and to create a game that we and our players will be satisfied with.

Cyber Manhunt 2: New World is expected to update Chapter 5 in January 2025. At the same time, the Early Access phase will end and the game will officially be in full release! We look forward to sharing the rest of the game with you and we thank you again for your trust and understanding towards us.

For all the latest updates, please follow us on our social media pages.

notes.title: We Hope You Enjoyed Our Demo!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Cyber Detectives!

We hope you enjoyed the demo of Cyber Manhunt 2: New World! We're filled with gratitude for each and every one of you who took the time to play our demo and share your feedback. Your feedback is invaluable as we strive to make the game the best it can be.

We are currently carefully reviewing each and every one of your suggestions and would like to take some time to share some highlights with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/f82f65f15d621c5fa34a329d0f656ebe3783fba5.png[/img]

We're humbled that over 90% of players rated Cyber Manhunt 2: New World and overall rating of 4 or 5! This is a fantastic start, but we know there's always room for improvement. With your continued feedback and support, we're committed to pushing that score even closer to a perfect 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/dd47ed9e61c7f8a8ec9d99f258f0b4b04aae473f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/093a69f425e988f885da9b1b39aea76f543e8233.png[/img]

The heart of our game lies in its storyline and gameplay, and we're happy to see that the majority of players enjoyed it. Our aim has always been to deliver a narrative that not only entertains but also resonates, drawing inspiration from real-world events to craft a story that's both engaging and thought-provoking. Knowing that we're on the right track is incredibly encouraging to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/5422178d2886b1afca925726c786bb0216d05c6a.png[/img]

We are grateful for your positive feedback on the real-life gameplay elements, and are delighted that they resonated with you. These elements are at the core of the immersive experience we aimed for, and we can’t wait for you to experience even more exciting gameplay elements that we have in store for the official release!


In addition, here are some of the top suggestions we've received:

[b]Clarity and Guidance:[/b] Some of you noted that progression could be hindered by unclear indications or a lack of guidance, especially when key information is hidden in chat dialogues. We're exploring ways to improve this and will work on providing clearer directions.

[b]Hint System:[/b] Implementing a hint system or more subtle nudges to aid players when they are unable to proceed further has been a popular request. We're considering how best to integrate these into the game without disrupting the challenge and satisfaction of solving puzzles on your own.

[b]Puzzle Clarity:[/b] We understand that some puzzles were challenging, leading to difficulties in completing the demo. We'll work on refining these aspects to ensure a more smoother and enjoyable gameplay experience.

While we may not be able to implement every suggestion, we're dedicated to finding a balance between meeting your expectations and staying true to our vision for the game. 

As we look ahead to prepare for our game launch, we'd like to update everyone that we will be taking the demo down on April 1st 2024. If you haven't tried the game yet, there is still time so be sure to try it out before then. Stay tuned for more updates in the coming weeks!

If you had a great time playing Cyber Manhunt 2: New World, please consider supporting us by wishlisting the game on Steam and sharing it with your friends. Your support means everything to us, and we're excited to continue this adventure with you.

notes.notes:
Hello Cyber Detectives,

We are excited to announce that the [b]Cyber Manhunt: New World demo is now live on Steam![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/586a0ba931c093811ea7d361fbb44e6a436230cf.png[/img]
This time limited demo will be available for you to play from February 5-29!

As we unveil this demo, we thought this would be a good time to offer a glimpse into the backstory of the original Cyber Manhunt game on how it has paved the way for Cyber Manhunt: New World, especially for those who haven't had the chance to play it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/1fddce0c6dd0cf6f2be50c0f906c6eaaf34ec016.gif[/img]

In Cyber Manhunt, you stepped into the shoes of an investigator at Titan Corporation, a powerful tech conglomerate. Under the guidance of the CEO Ashley, your journey began with a seemingly straightforward mandate: to solve cases using a blend of traditional detective work and an arsenal of social engineering tools. Some of your cases involve probing mysterious deaths, high-profile data leaks, looking into missing persons, scandals, and uncovering hidden secrets. 

But as you progressed, what started as standard investigation work quickly turned into something much more complicated. You found yourself unraveling a conspiracy that connected each case to the next. Each solved case brought you closer to understanding the influence of a hooded figure known only as Van. This mysterious character, initially just a suspect in your cases, soon emerged as the mastermind behind a series of interconnected incidents. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/640713c3e696d658c8859be811dfcf8fb3d090b3.gif[/img]

The climax of Cyber Manhunt was a revelation of Van's ultimate plan. His actions weren't random acts of cybercrime but were part of a well-planned scheme to destabilize the entire city. This led to a catastrophic event that left the city's infrastructure crippled and its citizens in turmoil. After this disaster, Van disappeared without a trace. In the aftermath, questions lingered about Van's true identity and motives. Was he a rogue agent, a symbol of resistance against corporate overreach, or something entirely different? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749015/dc43584ac192035ae72280d48eaf5123d0f1daa1.gif[/img]

These unresolved mysteries set the stage for Cyber Manhunt: New World. Expect a complex plot with interconnected stories, revealing vast conspiracies. As an AI detective in this sequel, you play a key role in rebuilding the city under Titan Corporation's new and ambitious AI project. Armed with even more social engineering tactics, you'll tackle intricate and interlinked cases, piecing together the larger mystery that blankets the city. But the question remains: will more dark secrets surface? Who is Van, really? Could Van, the elusive mastermind from the first game, make a comeback? 

We hope you've enjoyed this look into the backstory of Cyber Manhunt, setting the stage for the thrilling experiences awaiting you in the Cyber Manhunt: New World demo. Whether it’s something you enjoyed, a feature that you would like to see improved, or a bug you faced, we would be grateful if you could share it with us through this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1pwsRC-nJ5DYLtjC2HjBWjeAhN5B3ADTbivKZZ2txJAk/viewform?edit_requested=true.]form[/url]. It would go a long way in helping us improve and refine the game ahead!

In addition, we’re also hosting an exclusive giveaway event where you will stand a chance to win Steam gift cards! Simply follow the actions over on our Twitter page to join and stand a chance to win them.

notes.title: Welcome to Cyber Manhunt: New World!
notes.notes:
Hello Cyber Enthusiasts!

We’re the developers behind the award-winning Cyber Manhunt, a gripping cyber-hacking narrative puzzle game. Today, we are excited to bring to you the much-anticipated sequel to it — [b]Cyber Manhunt: New World! [/b]

[h2]Our Gripping Announcement Trailer![/h2]
[previewyoutube=RVMGl3zyoCc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What’s more, a free demo for the game is now available for you to play on Steam.[/b] For those of you who ventured deep into the enigmatic corridors of Cyber Manhunt, you know the thrill of unraveling the dark corners of the digital world. And if you're new to the game, fret not, you're in for an experience that's both captivating and thought-provoking!

[h2]About The Game[/h2]
Set against a backdrop reminiscent of its predecessor, Cyber Manhunt: New World immerses you in an engrossing cyber hacking narrative that resonates with the challenges of today's digital society. Play as an AI in a major corporation and navigate profound real-world challenges centered on big data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. Deploy an arsenal of intricate social engineering tactics to decipher concealed mysteries - while delving in tales shrouded in ambition and intrigue.

[h3]Real-World Inspired Storylines[/h3]
